company.shortDescription: Swadesh is a digital bank that allows customers to invest, remit, and manage their money in India from abroad.
company.description: Swadesh is a digital banking experience built from the ground up, specifically for the Indian diaspora. They make it delightful for its customers to invest, remit and manage their money in India from abroad.

productsAndServices.description: A US bank account that can be opened from India using a passport and visa, with no annual fees or minimum balance requirements.

productsAndServices.description: A card that helps build credit scores in the US without credit checks, interest rates, annual fees, or security deposits.
productsAndServices.name: Credit Builder Card

productsAndServices.description: A service to send money abroad from India with competitive foreign exchange rates and reduced transfer costs.
productsAndServices.name: Remittance Service

productsAndServices.description: Delivery of AT&T or T-Mobile SIM cards to India, allowing activation and use upon arrival in the US.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,611,729 to $13,067,321, a 8.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
